LeBron James listening to Gunna is all of us fr 😂🔥

LeBron James has never been shy about showing love to the rappers he listens to, and this Gunna post quickly became one of his funniest. In May 2024, LeBron posted himself in the car listening to “On One Tonight” from Gunna’s One of Wun, giving the album some love right after it dropped.

The song was already getting attention, but the flames filter over LeBron’s face made the whole video look completely ridiculous in the best way. He was just sitting in the car enjoying the song while looking like he had been set on fire, which was more than enough for the internet to turn the clip into a meme.

LeBron and Gunna have also known each other for years, with Gunna previously appearing on The Shop. So this wasn’t LeBron randomly discovering Gunna, he was showing love to an artist he’s clearly been a fan of. Still, the combination of LeBron passionately listening to Gunna and that ridiculous filter made this one impossible not to meme.
